$meta.product: BELL Suite Polish · BELL Explain PDF Viewer
$meta.author: Muse (UX Writer)

targets.pdfViewer: BELL-Explain src/components/PdfViewer.tsx (lines 213-250, PDF toolbar, document/page landmarks, password unlock, local-first missing-PDF notice, and open error states)

budgets.layoutNote: At 320px/360px narrow split-reader widths, visible toolbar text is restricted to fitWidth ('Fit width', 9 chars), while prev/next, zoom, and download controls stay icon-only with accessible aria-label/title copy.

rationale: Preserves all 21 shipped Taiwanese zh-TW strings verbatim from PdfViewer.tsx so existing UI snapshots and tests remain non-regressing.
Keeps the sole visible toolbar button label ('Fit width', 9 chars) within the <=10-character budget for 320px/360px narrow reader split panes.
Uses plain, reassuring beginner-friendly English ('damaged' instead of 'corrupted', browser-local password reassurance without technical jargon).

Keeps missingTitle and missingBody faithful to BELL Explain's local-first sync model: synced notes keep their explanations and extracted text readable even when the raw PDF remains on the server where it was originally uploaded.
assumptions: passwordPrivacyHint describes client-side PDF decryption inside PdfViewer.tsx where the entered password is passed only to the in-browser PDF renderer and never persisted or transmitted.
missingTitle and missingBody render when note metadata/text synced from another device or instance without transferring the original binary PDF file.
unlockAction ('Open') submits the in-browser password form and pairs with reopenAction ('Reopen') for retrying failed document loads.

pdfViewer.missingBody: 筆記可能來自另一個裝置的同步。解說與擷取文字仍可閱讀；原檔保存在上傳時的伺服器。

pdfViewer.passwordPrivacyHint: Your password is used only in this browser to open the file. It's never sent to a server or saved.
pdfViewer.missingTitle: Original PDF isn't on this server
pdfViewer.missingBody: This note may have synced from another device. You can still read the explanations and extracted text; the original file stays on the server where it was uploaded.
pdfViewer.errorBody: The file may be damaged or in an unsupported format.
